items.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Advances Seltorexant And Expands Outpatient Cardiac Care
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) is advancing its novel antidepressant Seltorexant into late stage clinical development for major depressive disorder as a potential rapid acting treatment option. The company also entered a multi year partnership with ACCESS to expand adoption of advanced cardiac electrophysiology technologies in ambulatory surgery centers.
